title: Mochizuki Honami — On The Music Video Set〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shoot Location

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It looks like the shoot's about to start, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
We gotta get focused. This shoot's really important!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. The weather and staff are both nice, so I'm sure we'll be able to shoot a wonderful video.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, let's all do our best today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, our best...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our best...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you two feeling nervous?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, umm...
I'm a little worried about my acting skills.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
The director did ask you to act a bit cool and mature for this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Exactly... I'm not sure how I'm going to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm not sure about my lines either...
Our voices aren't going to be recorded for this video, but we're still supposed to recite everything.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I practiced a lot, but I really have no idea how I'm going to do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
D-Don't worry!
It'll be okay as long as we get the right feel, they said.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They're both so nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I suppose that's only natural, since we haven't really done anything like this before. To be honest, I'm a bit anxious myself...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to do my best to get the ball rolling...! Especially since the shoot begins with the scene I'm in.)

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
We'll be starting momentarily!
Please take your position, Ms. Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay! Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (My scene involves me suggesting to the others that we take a break while holding a bottle of cider...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's my only line, but I need to stay focused. The director told me to smile and act natural...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, those two are watching me. They seem a bit worried...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I really need to do my best and help them relax...!)

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line:
Alright, rolling in...!
Three, two, one...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Let's take a bweak, everyone.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: U-Uhh... Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (H-How did my tongue get all twisted...?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was being so careful not to let that happen!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hee... Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha! It's okay, Hona! Just try to relax!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Don't worry. Your smile was beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just take a deep breath. You're too tense.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, this is so embarrassing...!

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay if you get tongue-twisted, since we're not recording your voice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line: And scene! Okay, that looked good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nice work, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Getting tongue-twisted right off the bat was so embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you did great after that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I thought you gave a nice smile.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
It felt like my face was beet red the entire time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I really wanted to get things off to a good start...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think you actually helped me relax, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
We realized that the staff wouldn't get mad at us if we messed up!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, did you do that to help diffuse the tension?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, I didn't!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I think we're starting the next scene!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The one with Ichika and me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we need to make use of the momentum Honami's given us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. Then, we'll be going.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They do seem much more relaxed now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure how I should feel about that, after stumbling right out the gates...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm glad Ichika and the others are smiling now.
